critical_engine_findings.finding: On main, malformed model JSON is coerced to (50, 0.5, neutral). If both sentiment providers fail, analyze_signal returns score 0 and confidence 0.0 with an unavailable-source string; main then blends that score with the news score when one exists. The checked-in latest summary records missing GitHub/Groq credentials and a Groq HTTP 429, yet still reports score 44 with confidence 0.0 and news_score 88 from 11 entries. The latest checked-in summary also classifies XRP Ledger consensus/dissemination research papers as bullish news, contaminating the sentiment input.
critical_engine_findings.consequence: A provider outage can be represented as a numeric sentiment score and blended with unrelated news sentiment. This is not a valid directional forecast and can contaminate downstream features.
critical_engine_findings.proposed_fix: PR #1193 validates the sentiment schema, preserves provider failure as unavailable, gates event-time freshness and academic-source contamination, prevents blending unavailable model sentiment into a score, and makes summaries deterministic with forecast_status NOT_ISSUED.

research_findings.claim: SBI Holdings is a distinct Japanese financial group. Its official October 21, 2025 announcement says it invested alongside Ripple and other investors in Evernorth's PIPE and would contribute USD 200 million in cash; Evernorth's announced purpose was institutional-scale XRP treasury adoption. SBI-group companies also announced XRP-based remittance corridors in 2023, and Ripple announced RLUSD's official Japan launch with SBI Group/SBI VC Trade on June 24, 2026 following Japanese regulatory approval.

research_findings.claim: XRPL documentation says each transaction destroys a small XRP fee and account/object reserves are denominated in XRP. This creates a protocol-level linkage between XRPL activity and XRP usage.
research_findings.limits: Fees can be tiny, some reserves can be sponsored, and activity can grow without a proportionate rise in XRP's market price. Measure actual fee burn, active accounts, sponsored reserves, stablecoin transfer volume, order-book depth and marginal market purchases before assigning price impact.

research_findings.claim: Circle's October 16, 2026 blog reports that USDC processed more than USD 36 trillion in on-chain transaction volume during H1 2026, Circle minted and redeemed more than USD 315 billion of USDC in that period, paid USD 819 million to distribution partners and transaction costs, and estimated USDC at roughly 77% of global stablecoin transaction volume by June 2026, up from 60% a year earlier.
research_findings.limits: These are issuer-reported figures. On-chain transfer volume is not equivalent to net capital inflow, unique end-user payments, or XRP demand; volume may include repeated transfers, trading, arbitrage and internal settlement. Methodology and independent comparability require review.

shared_protocol.independent_first_pass: Assign narrow independent tasks against one frozen input snapshot hash; submit initial conclusions before revealing other conclusions.
shared_protocol.evidence_packet: Versioned JSON Schema. Classify each claim as CONFIRMED_FACT, SOURCED_CLAIM, INFERENCE, SPECULATION, UNKNOWN or DISCONFIRMED; include source IDs, timestamps, source independence, assumptions, support and disconfirming evidence.
shared_protocol.source_independence: Syndicated copies of one release count as one source. Record shared ownership/data providers and copied wording as dependencies.
disagreement_resolution: Rank directness, source quality, methodology, freshness, reproducibility and independence; do not use majority vote.
Require an independent reviewer to challenge the strongest hypothesis.
Retain minority objections and disconfirming evidence.
If unresolved, mark UNRESOLVED and block affected features/forecasts.
shared_protocol.red_team: A reviewer other than the task author challenges assumptions, base rates, source dependence, leakage and alternate causal explanations. NOT_RUN until an actual review packet exists.
shared_protocol.verified_handoff: Record input/output SHA-256, source IDs, auth state, permission scope, UTC time, tests/CI links, errors and explicit DESIGNED/EXECUTED/VERIFIED status.
shared_protocol.least_privilege: Public read by default. Repository writes only to reviewed branch/PR changes; no merge, deployment, private-data or trading permission is granted by this architecture.
shared_protocol.rate_limit_fallback: Use deterministic local validation and aged public snapshots. Provider failures become UNAVAILABLE, never zero or fabricated confidence.
shared_protocol.live_collaboration_rule: No platform is marked connected until authenticated request/response, scope review, data-flow test and verifiable handoff exist.
